title: Mooring experimental 0.4 boundary envelopes
description: Draft only. Authentication is outside this schema. participant_ref resolves to a host-authenticated identity scoped to this session. CommitResult only comes from the host. Changes share indivisible outcomes; semantic validation must enforce cross-field atomicity, unique IDs, total limits, dependency validity and version compatibility. Schema coverage does not claim runtime protocol conformance. Arbitrary application payloads are separately schema/semantics validated; per-message authentication and trust directions are normative in SPEC v0.4. Binary snapshot byte/asset/aggregate limits require semantic validation. Messages introduced in 0.4 are proposed wire contracts, not implemented capabilities. x-direction annotations must become transport dispatch allowlists; schema validity alone is never authentication. Checkpoint/delta base64 pad bits, UTF-8 byte limits, ordering, identity, authorization, signature verification, per-op revision contiguity, and cross-message equality need semantic enforcement.

Counter.description: Canonical unsigned64 decimal string: 0..18446744073709551615 inclusive. Never parse through floating point.

payload.description: Application schema validates effects; generic schema does not prove semantic validity.

AtomicChange.description: task_id, when present, is immutable membership input; task_submit requires it equal the outer task_id. Untasked human changes may omit it.

ChangeResult.description: Saved: first_revision and last_revision REQUIRED, all operations saved and contiguous. Rejected: no revision range, all operations rejected. Cross-field semantics enforced by host validator.

control_profiles.description: Optional inherited-FD private bootstrap offer only. Absent preserves existing bootstrap. Participant transports must reject this field semantically.

StatusRequest.description: Authenticate and authorize this scoped outcome before lookup. For an authorized stored outcome, compare immutable stored fingerprint with expected_fingerprint before returning saved/rejected; mismatch is op_id_conflict. No authorized stored outcome is unknown, never saved or rejected. Never expose outcome existence or fingerprint differences to unauthorized callers.

DeliveryBlocked.description: ACK covers the exact host-assigned gate set for this barrier, scope, permission version and runtime generation. Host must aggregate all required ACK sets or wait for every remaining lease expiry. One gate ACK is not all-path revocation.

TaskSummary.description: Exactly one state per admitted change. Saved/rejected use immutable ChangeResult; pending/running/cancelled/unknown use explicit TaskChangeState. unresolved_change_ids equals unknown state IDs, not merely pending work. No omitted changes or invented receipts.

diff.description: Bounded display summary. The complete immutable changes remain available; never truncate the authoritative change set to fit this summary.

UndoRequest.description: One own task_id, one own target_change_id, or neither for latest own complete undoable atomic change. Both selectors are invalid. Author is bound to authentication.

selected_control_profile.description: Optional exact offered inherited-FD private control profile selection. Absent retains old262144 bound; never infer support from versions alone.

RuntimeReady.description: Version/readiness acknowledgement on the private inherited host RPC channel only. Carries no scope, participant identity, permissions, content or authority. Never a participant Welcome or durability receipt.

Identifier.description: 1..200 Unicode scalar values, excluding U+0000. Strict JSON rejects invalid Unicode before schema; no Unicode normalization. Does not constrain opaque application payload text.

OpaquePreparedCheckpoint.description: Full opaque app checkpoint. Digest is SHA256 of decoded bytes. E3 negotiated whole-frame bounds additionally apply; generic maxima unchanged. Private prepare profile decoded checkpoint limit1572864 bytes; canonical base64 including zero padding bits, digest equality checked before app interpretation.

PreparedOperationRevision.description: Host prospective contiguous per-op revision labels, not allocated or durable receipts. Runtime must not invent labels or issue Saved.

PrepareContext.description: Host-only trusted current complete target inventory and prospective labels. First-stage capability rejects stale observations, including causal stale reads. Human updates/provisional target reads/causal overlay not supported until separately qualified.

ValidateCheckpoint.description: Private inherited authenticated host RPC only. Full checkpoint validation and complete stable target inventory; never fake empty AtomicChange. Invalid checkpoint or uncertain engine failure closes the private channel; host Exchange aborts nonterminally, never a durable operation rejection.

CheckpointValidated.description: Private inherited RPC candidate validation result, not storage initialization or authority. Complete inventory includes retained tombstones; host assigns initial versions.

PrepareAtomic.description: Private inherited RPC only, actual admitted agent typed commands on confirmed current reads. Human Yrs updates unsupported. Full normalized immutable change; context is not fingerprint membership.

PreparedDirectFailure.description: Actual immutable failing member and valid direct terminal reason only. Host must validate attribution and durably record before terminal outcome. Unknown/ambiguous engine failures close the private channel and host aborts nonterminally.

AtomicPrepared.description: Private inherited RPC candidate/failure only. No Saved/issuer/durability/authority. Exact request/checkpoint/change/membership/per-op effect binding is semantic validation.

CausalReadIndex.description: Original immutable per-operation read index, canonical decimal 0..255.

QualifiedCausalRead.description: Trusted host attestation after complete durable dependency closure and every intervening target effect. Exact original read binding is mandatory; optional structure observation is absent, never null. Missing history is nonterminal, not uncovered.

CausalPrepareContext.description: Separate private causal profile only. Full entry inventory and exact original-read attestations; same-atomic effects still require original earlier dependency closure. No provisional created-target reads or human deltas.

ValidateCheckpointCausal.description: Separately negotiated causal inherited-host profile. Private inherited authenticated host RPC only. Full checkpoint validation and complete stable target inventory; never fake empty AtomicChange. Invalid checkpoint or uncertain engine failure closes the private channel; host Exchange aborts nonterminally, never a durable operation rejection.

CheckpointValidatedCausal.description: Separately negotiated causal inherited-host profile. Private inherited RPC candidate validation result, not storage initialization or authority. Complete inventory includes retained tombstones; host assigns initial versions.

PrepareAtomicCausal.description: Separately negotiated causal inherited-host profile. Private inherited RPC only, actual admitted agent typed commands on confirmed current reads. Human Yrs updates unsupported. Full normalized immutable change; context is not fingerprint membership.

AtomicPreparedCausal.description: Separately negotiated causal inherited-host profile. Private inherited RPC candidate/failure only. No Saved/issuer/durability/authority. Exact request/checkpoint/change/membership/per-op effect binding is semantic validation.

ConfirmedCheckpointBasis.description: Retained canonical checkpoint at an atomic boundary. Host checks inside the same SQL writer; not a client-asserted current head.

SessionOpen.description: Small initialization request. Does not grant participant authority. Runtime requests real OwnerGrant before accepting restoration. Named profile pins exact limits: 100ms/256ops/262144 encoded batch; 4 outstanding/1048576 encoded flight; 262144 unsent; 100 participants; per-gate input262144/global4194304; delivery default5000ms/configured1..5000ms; private frame2097152; queued controls4194304/128; transfer2097152/chunks65536/max32/reassembly4194304. No implicit numeric defaults or generic maximum advertisement.

SessionRestore.description: Only after correlated current OwnerGrant. Complete authenticated checkpoint and target inventory; no speculative candidate installation.

SessionOpened.description: Running confirmation only after full restoration. No authority or durability receipt.

SessionSubmitBatch.description: Explicit queued-submit. Host qualifies retained confirmed basis inside writer and derives CURRENT transport expected head there. Original immutable changes remain byte-semantic unchanged. Inner request raw/JCS <=262144 even on private2MiB channel.

SessionCommitResult.description: Bound exact host durable result plus authoritative resulting checkpoint/inventory. Whole encoded output fits negotiated capacity BEFORE COMMIT, not after. No receipt truncation or rewrite.

SessionParticipantOpen.description: Go-authenticated conduit binds opaque connection. Rust separately validates one-use ticket over inherited host channel and starts first-send BOOTTIME gate.

SessionParticipantInput.description: Inner public message remains <=262144 raw/JCS. Immutable mutations must first have exact host-sealed ingress proof; participant_ref alone is no author authority.

BoundedTransferBegin.description: Requires explicitly selected participant bounded_transfer_v1 feature. Only known inner grammar, total raw/JCS<=2097152, exactlyceil(total/65536) chunks<=32, one active/gate and aggregate reassembly<=4194304. Does not widen public raw/canonical per-frame262144.

BoundedTransferChunk.description: Strict canonical base64 incl padbits, decoded chunk<=65536. Exact increasingindex<chunk_count, all bindings match. Rust BOOTTIME and Go final gate before EACH chunk; closure discards partial. Whole digest and known inner shape/bindings verified before atomic installation.

SessionParticipantOutput.description: Go final bounded-send gate mandatory. Host-origin receipt must exactly match retained actual committed result/correlation; never infer Saved authority from issuer or child runtime. Inner ordinary public frames remain<=262144; large known payloads only chunked.

SessionJoinBounded.description: Separate explicit transfer-capable join. Old SessionJoin remains unchanged and cannot receive an overlimit checkpoint.

SessionJoinedBounded.description: Exact negotiated selection only when requested; unchanged SessionJoined bindings inside. No capability from unrequested feature.

SessionRestored.description: Echoes SessionRestore request_id after full restoration. SessionOpened separately echoes original SessionOpen request_id once owner+restore startup completed.

SessionStatusRequest.description: Host-captured FIFO barrier after every earlier accepted submit, never a child-selected sequence. Current external reader authorization before lookup; exact original fingerprint. Rust retains unsent/uncertain intent and never fabricates terminal unknown.

SessionStatusResult.description: Host-captured FIFO barrier after every earlier accepted submit, never a child-selected sequence. Current external reader authorization before lookup; exact original fingerprint. Rust retains unsent/uncertain intent and never fabricates terminal unknown.

AllocatedCrdtOrigin.description: Semantic bounded-profile validation requires origin<=9007199254740991 and clock<=4294967295. Zero origin may be occupied baseline; never an issued writer.

SessionInspectOrigins.description: Read-only application inventory; requires separately observed origin_inventory_v1 opt-in. Current fence and full creator provenance remain distinct. No issuance or access authority.

SessionOriginsInspected.description: Complete strictly sorted unique allocated origin/positive clock inventory for exact full checkpoint. Numeric validation and actual concrete adapter/runtime/full-basis/fence provenance are mandatory. No reservation, authority or inferred empty baseline.

SessionNativeDelta.description: Session human_native_prepare_v1 only. Actual application-state difference and writer identifier DATA, never source authority. Decoder verifies exact insertion origins, full replay and bounds; empty allocation_origins means no allocations, not an invented origin. Retain only with matched durable host outcome.

SessionSavedNativeDelta.description: Caller-trusted live host record bound to an actual Saved outcome and exact application checkpoint STATE bytes. This is not a participant assertion or full Checkpoint.Digest.

SessionSavedHumanPrefix.description: Exact immutable original own atomic linked to actual Saved transcript by reference/source/order. Its authored state digest stays untrusted intent until replay matches; the authored view is never labelled Saved.

replay_basis.description: Optional single earlier retained FULL checkpoint from the original own-prefix base. Original_basis remains the exact immutable current operation base; never selected by state vector or digest. Both are authenticated by the host writer and replay-qualified by the app.

SessionHumanPrepareContext.description: Only actual inherited session host after human_native_prepare_v1 negotiation may construct this optional context. All source/order/basis/history bindings derive from original authenticated live submissions and actual Saved outcomes. Not client authority; no durable issuer/journal implied. Single-operation human atomic only; generic causal agent preparation rejects this field.

SessionPreparedNativeDelta.description: Only a concrete earlier candidate from the SAME active SQL writer. The revision and state digest are prospective, not Saved. Actual original sealed source and candidate membership must match; never released as durable history before successful COMMIT.

SessionPreparedHumanPrefix.description: Exact immutable original own operation linked to a concrete earlier candidate in this SAME SQL writer. Its authored state digest is intent until replay matches. This is not an actual Saved prefix.

SessionPreparedPrefix.description: Separate bounded transaction-local candidate evidence. Actual Saved transcript ends at this exact transaction-start state; the app replays and verifies that raw-state hash, then each prospective candidate cut. No third checkpoint copy or pre-COMMIT Saved claim.
